    AI Overview
    View all
    Celebrate Easter 2026 with warm wishes for joy, renewal, and hope. Popular greetings include "Happy Easter!", "He is risen!", and "Wishing you a blessed Easter". Common messages focus on spring, togetherness, and faith, such as wishing for a day filled with love, laughter, and chocolate eggs. 
    Family and Friends 
    • "To my wonderful family—you make every holiday brighter. I love you all!"
    • "Happy Easter to my favorite peeps! Life is sweeter with friends like you."
    • "Wishing you an Easter that’s as bright and cheerful as the springtime flowers".
    • "Sending you joy, love, and sunshine this Easter!" 
    Faith-Based/Religious 
    • "He is risen! Wishing you a blessed Easter filled with faith and joy".
    • "May the miracle of Easter bring you peace and new hope".
    • "Wishing you a joyous reminder of God's love for us". 
    Short & Funny (For Social Media) 
    • "I'm just hopping by to wish you a Happy Easter!"
    • "No yolk—life's better with you in my basket!"
    • "Sending you egg-stra special wishes today!" 
    For more inspiration, you can explore specialized, heartfelt messages at American Greetings.

    AI Overview
    Wishing everyone a joyous and blessed Easter filled with love, peace, and new beginnings! May this special day bring happiness to you and your family, accompanied by warmth, sunshine, and plenty of cherished moments. Celebrate the hope and renewal of the season. Happy Easter! 
    Warm & Joyful Easter Wishes 
    • "Wishing you and your family a blessed and joyful Easter!"
    • "May your Easter be filled with love, joy, peace, and countless blessings."
    • "Warmest wishes for a happy Easter! May you be blessed with the Lord's love and peace."
    • "Happy Easter! Sending you joyful hugs and wishing your basket is full of blessings and treats."
    • "Hope your Easter is eggs-tra special this year! Happy Spring!" 
    Inspirational Easter Messages 
    • "May the miracle of Easter bring you perfect peace and happiness."
    • "Celebrate the new life and hope this wonderful Easter season brings."
    • "Rejoice in the spirit of Easter with love in your heart and a spring in your step!"
    • "May the spirit of Easter bring you and your family a festivity full of joy and happiness" 
    Short Easter Greetings 
    • "Happy Easter to every bunny!"
    • "Wishing you an egg-stra hoppy day!"
    • "Enjoy the egg hunts and sweet treats—Happy Easter!"
    • "Christ is risen! Wishing you a blessed and holy Easter."

      Description

      Easter, also called Pasch or Pascha or Resurrection Sunday, is a Christian festival and cultural holiday commemorating the resurrection of Jesus from the dead, described in the Bible's New Testament as having occurred on the third day of his burial following his crucifixion by the Romans at Calvary c. 30 AD.
